$comment: The source of sf-chart-waterfall (standard simai.smart-component 1.3.14 in the 1.4 form, vocabulary 1.1.5). The parameters are docs/research/catalogue.md of ui-chart (Waterfall), the keyboard docs/research/rendering.md §3.1, the renderer D5, the name and the form the owner's choice of 2026-11-04 (docs/DECISIONS.md D11).

label.summary: What the chart shows, in a few words: its accessible name and the table's caption. Required in practice: without it the chart is named «График».

items.summary: The data: a list of records, one per step ([{step, value, total}, …]), or an object of columns. A step is a change from the running total; a row marked as a total stands on zero. A change without a value is left out; the summary says how many.

colors.summary: The colours of rise, fall and total: {up: 'success', down: 'error', total: 'neutral'} by default. A colour is a Framework role, which follows the theme, or any CSS colour or variable; anything else is dropped with a console report, as is a colour under 3:1 against the background (drawn all the same). Each bar's value keeps its sign whatever the colour.

x.summary: The field of the steps' names, in the data's order; the first field other than the value and the total mark when unset.

y.summary: The field of the values: a change (positive or negative) on a step, the total itself on a total row; the first numeric field other than x and the total mark when unset.

total.summary: The field that marks a total row (true, 1, «yes» or «да»). A total row stands on zero: without a value it shows the running total, with one the running total starts again from it, as an opening balance does.

end.summary: auto closes the steps with a total named «Итого» unless the last row is a total already; none draws the rows only.

value-labels.summary: auto writes each bar's value on it, a change with its sign and a total as it is, when every one fits its band; none leaves them to the tooltip and the table.

legend.summary: auto shows the key of rise, fall and total above the plot.

tooltip.summary: step: under the pointer or the cursor, the step's name, its change and the total it reaches.

grid.summary: value draws guide lines across the plot at the value ticks.

x-label.summary: The name of the steps, said under the axis and as the table's first column; the x field's name when unset.

y-label.summary: The name of the value, said above the axis.

y-format.summary: The values' format: number, integer, decimal-<n>, compact, currency-<CODE> or unit-<unit>, in the page's language.

size.summary: The rung of the size ladder: the plot's height, the text and the gaps. 1/2 for a card, 2 for a page of its own.

table.summary: The same data as a table: toggle offers a button that swaps the plot for it, visible shows it under the plot, hidden keeps it for screen readers only. Never none: the table is the chart's text.

summary.summary: auto: a sentence of what the data does (the count of changes, the start and the end with the change between them, the step that added most and the one that took away most, how many rose and fell), said before the plot. The description slot adds the host's own words.

data-state.summary: auto: ready with steps, empty without. loading draws the frame without marks; error offers «Повторить», which sends refresh.

select.summary: The person chose a step: a click on its band, or Enter or Space on the keyboard cursor. index is its place among the bars, row its row in items (-1 for the closing total the chart adds), x its name, kind up, down or total, value the change (the total itself on a total), total the level it reaches.

refresh.summary: The person asked for the data again from the error state; the host loads it and sets items.

description.$comment: The host's own words about the chart: said with the summary (aria-describedby) and shown under the plot.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16); the plot is SVG (D5): a waterfall has a bar per step, a few dozen at most.

skeleton.$comment: The items arrive after the first paint when the host loads them: the derived skeleton holds the plot's box (its height is the size rung's) until they do (standard 1.3.8 §5.4).

accessibility.x-keys: The plot is one Tab stop (role group, aria-roledescription «каскадный график»). Left and Right move the cursor from step to step; Home and End to the ends; Page Up and Page Down a tenth at a time. Each move is said in a polite live region: the step's name, its change with its sign and the total it reaches. Enter and Space choose the step (select); Escape takes the cursor away. The table button is a button of its own.

x-summary: A waterfall chart: how a start value becomes an end value through positive and negative steps, a bar per step on a value axis from zero, a change floating from the running total and a total standing on zero, joined by thin lines, in the success, error and neutral tones with each value written with its sign, a closing total added, a key, a tooltip, a keyboard cursor over the steps, a summary in words, and the same data as a table.
x-decisions: name: sf-chart-waterfall, the Framework's naming rule sf-[set]-<block>[-<variant>], block chart, as the charts of M2 (the owner's choice of 2026-11-04; docs/DECISIONS.md D11), family chart. Sent to the dispatcher for reservation on 2026-11-04.

own tag, not the accumulate setting on sf-chart-bar the catalogue proposed: its colours go by direction, not by series, it has total rows, joining lines and a closing total, and the bar's series, stack, bin, sort and lines have no meaning on it (D11).
data: x and y as on the bar chart (D3), and a total field marking the rows that stand on zero; a total row with a value starts the running total again, as an opening balance.
a closing total («Итого») is added unless the last row is a total; end=none draws the rows only.
the value axis always takes zero in: a total is an amount, drawn from zero, as a bar is.
direction never rests on colour: each bar's value is written with its sign; in forced colours a rise is hollow, a fall filled and a total dashed.
colours: the success, error and neutral roles' graphic tones by default, so they follow the theme; colors {up, down, total} for a page's own.
renderer: own SVG (D5); a waterfall has a few dozen steps at most, so there is no canvas layer and no merging.
keyboard: the arrows of rendering.md §3.1 along one series (chart-core/cursor): Left and Right from step to step; there is no series to cross.
select: {index, row, x, kind, value, total}.
table: never none; one row per step with its change and the total it reaches.
horizontal orientation and stacked steps: not in 0.1.0.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-chart-waterfall to show how a start value becomes an end value through positive and negative steps: a profit bridge, a budget's changes, a headcount's moves.
do_not: Do not draw a chart without a label
Do not use it for independent values that do not add up; a sf-chart-bar reads them
Do not use it for a change over many periods; a sf-chart-line shows a trend

accessibility.focus: One Tab stop on the plot, then the table button. The summary is the plot's description; each cursor move is said politely.

$comment: The chart draws its empty and error states as sf-empty-state; a tag it renders is a tag it fetches.
Its own button (the table toggle) is a native button, so it fetches no sf-button.
